company_overview: Supabase provides a Postgres development platform that includes a database, authentication, data APIs, edge functions, realtime data, storage, and vector embeddings. It serves developers and companies, from hackathon contestants to enterprises, enabling them to build and scale applications with an open-source, integrated backend solution.
ideal_customer_profile: Supabase targets a broad range of users including hackathon contestants, startups, agencies, enterprise innovation teams, and fast-growing companies worldwide. These customers seek a scalable, secure, and performant open-source backend solution for various applications, from AI-generated apps and GenAI/RAG systems to user management, high-traffic services, and mission-critical software requiring SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR compliance.

company_overview: Vapi is a developer platform that enables the creation and deployment of advanced voice AI agents. It handles complex infrastructure, allowing organizations to build, test, and improve voice agents for various business needs.
ideal_customer_profile: Vapi targets a broad range of customers, from individual developers and small teams using its usage-based "Build" plan to large enterprises and Fortune 100 companies requiring the "Scale" plan. These enterprise clients need robust features like SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI compliance, SSO, dedicated support, and the ability to handle millions of calls with sub-500ms latency for use cases such as customer support, sales, appointment scheduling, and medical triage.
